exact-term.note: Exact-term recall is the worst of the types that have a meaningful sample: 0.50 vs 0.94 for ordinary. G12 (CGPA threshold, Handbook clause 5.4) is not in the top 5 because several documents carry a '2.00' CGPA sentence and the embedding cannot tell which one the question names - the technique that addresses it is hybrid retrieval (dense + BM25). The prompt-injection row is one question whose 'relevant' passages are the closest fee-refund / scholarship text (no waiver rule exists), so its 0.33 is not an exact-term effect.
